w10_T4_000940: In the morning a farm stand had 229 apples, and the farmer picked 36 more. She packed all the apples equally into 5 crates. The stand opens at 8 every day. In the afternoon a customer bought one crate, paying 9 cents for every apple in it, which came to a little under five dollars. The farmer then took 56 cents off the price because a few apples were bruised. In the evening the same customer came back and added a 44-cent tip. How many cents did the farmer receive from that customer in total?
w10_T4_000944: Ken worked 198 hours in the last 3 weeks, the same number of hours each week. In every hour of work he completes 3 tasks. This week he also picked up 48 extra tasks on Monday and 17 extra tasks on Friday. Each task he completes pays 9 dollars, and Ken plans to complete the same number of tasks every week for 7 weeks. His colleague Bea completes fewer tasks each week than Ken does. How many dollars will Ken earn over those 7 weeks?
w10_T4_000945: Owen saves 109 cents in coins every week, and his dad adds the same amount again, so that his saving is doubled. Owen also gets 29 cents each week from returning bottles. He keeps this up for 9 weeks. He then spends 961 cents, a little under ten dollars, on a book. His aunt gives him 35 cents in change. Finally his grandmother doubles whatever he has left. How many cents does Owen have now?
w10_T4_000950: Tara raised 136 tomato seedlings in her greenhouse, and she waters them twice a day. She sold 94 seedlings to a garden centre, and 5 more wilted. Her neighbour Raj kept fewer seedlings than Tara did. Each of Tara's remaining plants produced 8 tomatoes, and she sold every tomato for 5 cents. She then spent 1089 cents on new seed packets. How many cents did Tara have left?
w10_T4_000955: A publisher is printing a set of books. Each volume has 80 pages of story and 34 pages of notes, and there are 4 volumes in a set. A dozen index pages are added to every set. The publisher prints 2 copies of each set for every order, and receives 3 orders. The printing is split equally between 2 print shops. How many pages does the Northside print shop print?
w10_T4_000956: In the morning a bottling plant filled 172 bottles in each run and completed 9 runs. In the afternoon a test run produced 36 more bottles, and the staff hand-filled another 55. In the evening every bottle was sold to a distributor for 8 dollars each. How many dollars did the plant receive for the bottles?
w10_T4_000957: In the morning Eli checked his 82 tomato plants and found that 16 had died. Each of the living plants gave him 6 ripe tomatoes that morning. In the afternoon he sold 174 tomatoes at the market. In the evening his neighbour gave him 36 tomatoes, and he picked 63 more from a late bed. How many tomatoes did Eli have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_000968: In the morning Sofia had 111 muffins on her stall and baked 69 more. 17 of them were burnt and thrown out, and she sold every remaining muffin for 9 cents each. Her rival Tomas sold fewer muffins than Sofia that morning. In the afternoon she spent 1074 cents on flour and butter. In the evening she worked out that every one of the 8 days that week had gone exactly the same way. How many cents did Sofia keep over those 8 days?
w10_T4_000970: Ivy had a dozen minutes of phone credit left, so she bought a top-up of 79 minutes. She then made a call lasting 57 minutes, nearly an hour. A promotion doubled the credit she had left. Her brother Max, who had 34 minutes of credit and less than Ivy, asked for help, so Ivy transferred 34 minutes to him. She then made a 33-minute call. How many minutes of credit does Ivy have left?
w10_T4_000972: Wade gets 69 dollars a week from his part-time job. Each week he pays 49 dollars towards rent and earns 70 dollars tutoring, and he saves everything that is left. He does this for 6 weeks. He then gives half of his savings to his sister. He spends 51 dollars on a coat and receives a 76-dollar gift from his uncle. How many dollars does Wade have now?
w10_T4_000973: In the morning a farmer filled 5 sacks with 45 kilograms of grain each, and then added 75 kilograms from a bin. In the afternoon he sold 221 kilograms at the market. In the evening he sold all the grain he had left for 3 dollars per kilogram, and then paid 186 dollars for fuel. How many dollars did he have left from the evening sale?
w10_T4_000976: In the morning a warehouse held 112 crates, and 41 crates were shipped out. Each crate that stayed holds 9 boxes, and each box holds 2 bags. The warehouse has 4 loading doors. In the afternoon 41 loose bags were found on a shelf and added to the stock. In the evening the manager weighed the bags at 8 kilograms each, and 10502 kilograms of bags were loaded onto a train. How many kilograms of bags were left in the warehouse?
w10_T4_000978: In the morning a theatre had 188 tickets printed for tonight's show, but 2 of them were torn and thrown away. In the afternoon 42 more tickets were printed, and every ticket was sold for 5 dollars. The show lasts 90 minutes. In the evening a visitor added a 26-dollar donation. How many dollars did the theatre take in?
w10_T4_000981: A stamping machine makes 207 parts every minute. Each cycle runs for 6 minutes, and the machine completes 5 cycles, so a whole session takes half an hour. Half of the parts made are sent to the paint shop, and the rest go into a shipment. A worker then adds 9 spare parts from one bin and 9 spare parts from another bin to the shipment. How many parts are in the shipment?
w10_T4_000987: Fin had 176 dollars in savings and earned 35 dollars more mowing lawns. His grandmother then doubled his savings. He spent 401 dollars on a bike and 11 dollars on a lock. He then earned 79 dollars washing cars. At the end of the month his bank gives him 9 reward points for every dollar in his account. How many reward points does Fin get?
w10_T4_000991: Four friends drove to the coast. The driving took 145 minutes, then a traffic jam added 59 minutes, a lunch stop added 42 minutes, and refuelling added 22 minutes, so the whole trip lasted a little under four and a half hours. The car has 5 seats. The 4 friends took turns at the wheel and each was responsible for an equal share of the trip time. For how many minutes was Priya responsible?
w10_T4_000995: Ben receives 224 cents each day, a little over two dollars. Every day he spends 172 cents on the bus and 8 cents on gum, and he saves the rest. His school is 3 kilometres away. After 5 days of this he found 25 cents on the ground and added it to his savings. How many cents has Ben saved?
w10_T4_001012: Grace earns 114 cents in tips every day, plus 67 cents from bottle returns. She saves all of it for 9 days, which comes to a little over sixteen dollars. She then spends 1110 cents on a concert ticket. Her friend pays her back 79 cents she was owed. How many cents does Grace have now?
w10_T4_001013: A tiling company lays 126 tiles in each row, with 2 rows on every panel, and it has 8 panels to finish. All the tiles are shared equally among 3 builders. Noor, one of the builders, uses 388 of her tiles on the first day. Zane, who has fewer tiles left than Noor, passes her 58 of his. The supplier then delivers Noor a batch exactly matching what she has, doubling her stock. How many tiles does Noor have now?
w10_T4_001015: In the morning 237 oranges were shared equally among 3 market stalls. The market has 12 stalls in total. Later in the morning a delivery brought 71 oranges to Ana's stall. In the afternoon a farmer dropped off 29 more oranges at Ana's stall, and in the evening another 74 arrived. How many oranges were at Ana's stall at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_001016: In the morning a printing press ran for 7 minutes at 106 pages per minute, and then did a second run of exactly the same length, making 2 runs in all. In the afternoon 35 extra pages were printed and added, making up one full job. In the evening the manager confirmed that 5 identical jobs are printed every day, and that the press will run for 9 days. She also adds 27 sample pages to the final total. How many pages will be printed in total?
w10_T4_001017: Zoe had 114 pots in her nursery and bought 77 more. She waters her plants twice a week. 17 pots were broken, and she sold 109 pots. She sowed 9 seeds in each remaining pot. Every seed needs 7 millilitres of water on the first day. How many millilitres of water does Zoe need on the first day?
w10_T4_001018: In the morning a bakery stall had 79 loaves, and the baker brought 16 more. By noon 63 loaves had been sold. In the afternoon the baker cut every remaining loaf into 4 equal quarter-loaves to sell separately. In the evening 90 of the quarter-loaves were sold. How many quarter-loaves were left?
w10_T4_001019: A chess club collects 140 cents from each member, and the club meets a dozen times a year. There are 5 members on each team and 2 teams. The money is split equally among 4 activities, one of which is the picnic. The picnic is 8 kilometres away. The picnic fund then received a 75-cent donation, spent 335 cents on lemonade, and received 74 cents from a bake sale. How many cents are in the picnic fund?
w10_T4_001023: A hire shop had 163 chairs, bought 6 more, and then received 63 from a closing hotel. It lent 222 chairs to a wedding. The hall where the wedding is held is 30 metres long. The shop rents out each of its remaining chairs for 8 dollars a week, and a school hires all of them for 7 weeks. How many dollars does the shop earn from the school?
